prompt:
Subject: A baseball scoreboard marking the active inning.

Composition: Show one baseball scoreboard on sturdy posts with nine narrow inning columns numbered 1 through 9. Highlight the third column, with completed run entries only beneath the first two columns; a batter and catcher wait at a small home-plate area below.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. Allow only inning-column numerals 1 through 9 and small run-score digits in the first two columns; no team names or headings. No incidental labels, logos or watermark.
For each human: exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands.
en: The scoreboard highlights the third inning as the batter and catcher wait at home plate.
ja: 打者と捕手がホームベースで待つ中、スコアボードは3回を強調しています。
